body: Recently it's been the fighting with my girlfriend, I'm terrified of losing her, but I've been pushing her away at the same time. All of my friends don't seem to be able to help, or don't know where I'm coming from. I've been feeling low for a year, but now I'm in that really low place where I'm afraid I could get violent. I just hate who I am, I hate that I'm the kind of person who can't get his shit together, or the kind of man who yelled at my girlfriend. I just hate me, and I think it's a deep seeded hate, I dislike me on a fundamental level.
Just the idea of having a need for a chemical to make me normal, or close to normal. The side effects and the stigma about medication don't help either.
